abstract: Prenatal diagnosis of epignathus (a teratoma originating in the oropharynx) has been reported previously. However, in many of these cases the neonates succumbed to acute respiratory distress secondary to airway obstruction at the time of birth. We describe a case of antepartum diagnosis of epignathus using ultrasonography and magnetic resonance imaging as complementary techniques. The ability to accurately define the fetal anomaly permitted us to plan a unique strategy for peripartum management. After cesarean delivery of the infant from the uterus, the umbilical cord was not clamped and the fetoplacental circulation was left undisturbed. A tracheostomy was then performed, after which the umbilical cord was clamped and the infant was stabilized. Several hours later, a debulking procedure was performed in the operating room to remove the tumor from its attachment to the bony palate. Both mother and infant did well postoperatively. The ability to plan and perform a controlled tracheostomy while the infant remained oxygenated and ventilated proved to be lifesaving in this case.
abstract_ja: エピグナサス（口腔咽頭由来の奇形腫）の出生前診断は既に報告されている。しかし、これらの症例の多くでは、出生時の気道閉塞による急性呼吸窮迫で新生児が死亡していた。超音波検査と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)を補完的に用い、胎児の異常を正確に確認した症例を報告する。その結果、周産期管理の戦略を立てることができた。帝王切開後、臍帯を結紮せずに胎盤循環を温存し、気管切開を行った。その後臍帯を結紮し、手術室で腫瘍の減量切除を行った。母児ともに術後の経過は良好であった。酸素化と人工換気を保ったまま、制御された気管切開を計画・実施できたことが、本症例の救命につながった。
